blocks.text: The Zscaler service provides a number of ways to provision users, groups, and departments as described in About Provisioning and Authentication Methods. You can also add departments when you configure policies. This article describes how to add a department on the Departments page in the Zscaler Admin Console.
You can use a CSV file to add multiple departments at once.

blocks.item: Go to Administration > Internet & SaaS Authentication > Internet & SaaS Users.
On the Departments tab, click Add Department.
Department Name: Enter a department name.
Comments: Optionally, enter additional notes or information. The content cannot exceed 10,240 characters.
Click Save and activate the change.

blocks.text: After creating the department, you can add users to it.
